messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> INC-82319: SOUTHAMERICA-az1 capacity degradation (cpu pressure + connection churn) :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: INC-82319 triggered, services impacted: inference-routing, prefix-cache. Paging: alex (primary), priya (sre), jamal (runtime).
alex (oncall): acked. I'm looking now. pinging priya + jamal.
priya (sre): I'm in. initial read: controlplane is seeing high RPC latencies to SOUTHAMERICA-az1, several control-plane pods OOM-killed in last 5m. host-level CPU spiking on a subset of nodes.
jamal (eng-runtime): seeing 5xx surge on inference-gateway for models pinned to sa-east-az1. KV cache eviction counts spiked, cache hit rate down from 86% -> 42% in 3m.
liu (eng-sre): checking autoscaler logs. looks like the nodepool failed to scale due to transient cloud API 429s — autoscaler loop retried and then rate-limited. rolling back recent autoscaler config change?
sara (prodops): customer-impact: roughly 12% of requests are failing with 502/504s, affecting a small set of customers who are pinned to SA region. Not global yet. Workflows with low-latency SLOs seeing timeouts.
alex (oncall): plan: 1) enable region fallback routing (route ~30% traffic away from sa-east-az1 to sa-east-az2) 2) trigger emergency scale-up of reserved capacity 3) open handoff to priya after initial mitigation. attempting fallback now.
jamal (eng-runtime): rolling fallback weights now. command:
```
redwoodctl routing adjust --region sa-east --from az1 --to az2 --weight 30
```
will monitor QPS and 5xx.
priya (sre): starting nodepool scale-up via cloud console + increasing autoscaler backoff window. also temporarily disabling the new autoscaler throttling patch to restore previous behavior.
mika (support): FYI support is standing by to notify impacted customers; hold public comms until we have stable fallback in place.
incident-bot: Routing change accepted, rollout id rr-5539. estimated gradual shift over 60s.
jamal (eng-runtime): seeing initial drop in 5xxs for routed traffic. overall 5xx still elevated, but az2 baseline is stable. KV cache hit still low for az1 pinned requests.
priya (sre): manual scale requested: adding +8 nodes to sa-east-az1 reserved pool. issuing cloud command:
```
cloudctl nodepool resize --region sa-east --zone az1 --add 8 --type reserved
```
pending.
liu (eng-sre): autoscaler logs show cloud API 429 spikes subsided ~30s ago; manual resize should succeed.
sara (prodops): monitoring error budget burn. currently projected to breach customer SLA for one large tenant if not fully mitigated in 20m.
alex (oncall): if manual scale doesn't land in 5m, we'll activate DR fallback to route 60% of traffic to az2 and enable degraded LRU caching on az2 for pinned models. Priya you'll own handoff when scaling completes.
priya (sre): scaling complete. new nodes joined, kube-controller showed pods scheduled. starting prefix-cache warmup on new nodes.
jamal (eng-runtime): prefix-cache warmup triggered with seed set from snapshot compression. command:
```
redwoodctl cache warmup --region sa-east --zone az1 --snapshot latest
```
observed cache hit climbing 42% -> 71% over 3m. 5xxs trending down.
mika (support): started targeted outbound to impacted customers with short status note. kept minimal. :white_check_mark:
alex (oncall): excellent. handing off to priya for watch and postmortem. Priya, please confirm if PD can be suppressed or we should keep paging.
priya (sre): will keep paging to oncall for 30m, then suppress if stability holds for 20m. creating incident ticket and tagging eng-runtime + prodops for postmortem.
liu (eng-sre): quick action items: 1) revert autoscaler throttling patch to a safe rollout 2) add stronger cloud API retry/backoff on nodepool resize paths 3) add synthetic checks for cache hitrate degradation.
sara (prodops): capturing impact metrics and customer list for RCA. will coordinate with support on messaging.
alex (oncall): thanks team. summary: PD fired due to node-level CPU pressure + autoscaler rate limits causing insufficient capacity -> KV cache evictions -> elevated 5xxs for sa-east-az1. Mitigation: routing fallback to az2, manual reserved scale-up, cache warmup. Services stabilizing. handoff to priya for monitoring/postmortem. :lock:
